note: Suggestion & decision queue. Every item is a proposal with options and a recommendation, status 'awaiting review' until the owner picks a path. Implementations that could not wait (site naming, link policy) shipped provisionally and are marked as such. Nothing here is a claim of product superiority, popularity, or search volume.

suggestions.title: Site brand and masthead
suggestions.context: The publication needs a name that reads like a shop/editorial title, not a data audit.

options.label: The Crisp Index
options.pros: Kitchen-specific, publication cadence, works as a noun ('the index')

options.label: Counter & Crisp
options.pros: Warm, spatial (counter space is a core theme)
options.cons: Ampersand names are harder to type

options.label: The Kitchen Ledger
options.cons: Too close to the audit tone we're avoiding

suggestions.feeds_into: Masthead, SEO titles, feed, social copy

suggestions.title: Publishing cadence and topic selection loop
suggestions.context: The brief: publish question-shaped guides on a cadence, add each to the sitemap and feed, and choose the next topic from measured queries instead of instinct.

options.label: 2 question-shaped guides/month + 1 seasonal anchor
options.pros: Sustainable, leaves room for verification work
options.cons: Slow ramp in the first quarter

options.label: 4 guides/month

suggestions.recommendation: Option a; revisit after 90 days of Search Console query data (SUG-008).

suggestions.title: Five-event analytics schema (proposal for the brief's undefined 'five defined events')
suggestions.context: The brief requires recording 'the five defined events' but does not enumerate them (Q-003). A concrete, privacy-preserving proposal:

options.label: page_view, outbound_click, guide_read, newsletter_signup, feedback_click
options.pros: Covers reach → interest → intent → capture → voice; no PII; no cookies

options.label: page_view, outbound_click, cta_click, newsletter_signup, feedback_click

suggestions.recommendation: Option a (implemented in analytics.js, sending disabled until the endpoint is deployed — FLG-006).

suggestions.title: Analytics endpoint hosting
suggestions.context: The brief demands a self-hosted analytics endpoint; GitHub Pages is static (FLG-006).

options.label: Cloudflare Worker + KV/D1 (reference impl in tools/analytics-endpoint)
options.pros: Free tier, global edge, trivial deploy via wrangler

options.label: Small VPS/Fly.io Python server (reference impl ships)
Privacy-focused third party (e.g. GoatCounter)
options.cons: Not self-hosted — deviates from the brief

suggestions.recommendation: Option a; endpoint accepts only {event, path, ts, ref}, drops IP and user agent at the edge.

suggestions.title: Reader capture (newsletter) stack
suggestions.context: SG-30 reader capture; the form ships but collects nothing until an endpoint exists (FLG-008).

options.label: Listmonk self-hosted
options.pros: Matches self-host preference, full data control

options.label: Buttondown
Keep the form gated until there is a first issue to send
options.pros: No dead list, no consent rot

suggestions.recommendation: Option c for 30 days, then a or b before the second guide batch ships.

Integrate Product Advertising API for live price/rating
